description: List the services pekt can point a domain at, grouped as web (where the site or app is hosted) and mail (who receives e-mail): Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Cloud Run, Cloudflare Pages, Firebase, Render, Fly.io, Lovable, Replit, Webflow, Framer, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proton Mail, Fastmail, iCloud Mail, plus custom IP or host targets and "none". For each: its key, group, name and the inputs the user must copy from the provider. Use it when the user is building a site or app, or setting up e-mail, and needs to connect a domain; then call dns_records. No lookups.
name: list_services
title: Services pekt can point a domain at
